army_rules.name: Waaagh!
army_rules.flavor_text: The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from countless toothy maws, it galvanises the Orks and riles them into a raucous state of excited aggression.
army_rules.rules_text:
Friendly ORKS units with this ability can re-roll Advance rolls and become riled up, as stated in other rules. While a unit is riled up, it has a 5+ invulnerable save, its ranged attacks have [ASSAULT], and when it is selected to make an Advance move, that Advance does not prevent it from being eligible to declare a charge.

War Cry (once per battle, per army): At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.

army_rules.name: Da Boss
army_rules.flavor_text: Whether capable of kunnin' strategy or favouring something far less complicated, the biggest Ork tends to have a voice as aggressive and brutal as the rest of him. His bellows can be heard over the thickest fighting and his reputation ensures the ladz do as they're told.
army_rules.rules_text: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

army_rules.name: Unstable Energies
army_rules.flavor_text: Ork psykers - Weirdboyz and their unsavoury ilk - release the painful build-up of Waaagh! energy in sudden discharges of power, usually with spectacularly lethal results.
army_rules.rules_text: ORKS PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name. In a battle round, a friendly ORKS PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit's psyker level.

army_rules.name: Special Move Types
army_rules.rules_text:
Pulse Jet Move: Maximum distance Pulse roll + 18". Eligible if a unit has a rule allowing this move type. Before moving, make a Pulse roll by rolling one D6. While moving, ignore all vertical distance for how far the unit has moved; the unit can move through all types of model and can move horizontally and vertically through all categories of terrain feature. After moving, the unit must be unengaged, is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn, and until the start of your next turn attacks that target the unit have -1 to Hit rolls.

Assault Disembark Move: Set-up distance 3". Eligible if embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield, did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase, and that TRANSPORT has not made an Advance/Fall Back move this phase. Set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

rule.name: Mob-handed Brutality
rule.rules_text: Friendly BOYZ units' melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. If a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit made a Charge move this turn, its melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].

enhancements.name: Ferocious Show-off
enhancements.rules_text: ORKS INFANTRY model only. This model's melee attacks have +1 Attacks, or +2 Attacks while this unit has 11 or more models.

enhancements.name: 'Ardboyz
enhancements.rules_text: BOYZ unit only. This unit has a 4+ Save characteristic.

stratagems.name: Unbridled Carnage
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when a friendly BOYZ unit that made a Charge move this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have +1 Attacks.

stratagems.name: Mob Mentality
stratagems.timing: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit of 13+ models.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12 inches of your unit. That unit automatically succeeds on its Battle-shock rolls.

stratagems.name: 'Ere We Go
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ or BOYZ unit is selected to move.
stratagems.target: That BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ or BOYZ unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2 to Advance rolls.

rule.name: Displays of Savagery
rule.rules_text: Friendly MEGANOBZ and NOBZ units' melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Minik Killa
enhancements.rules_text: NOBZ unit only. When an enemy unit engaged with this unit is selected to Fall Back, it must make a Desperate Escape. If this unit is riled up, that enemy has -1 to its hazard rolls.

enhancements.name: Tellyporta Boss
enhancements.rules_text: MEGA ARMOUR model only, excluding VEHICLE models. This unit has Deep Strike.

stratagems.name: Too Arrogant to Die
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit.
stratagems.effect: When a model is destroyed before its unit has fought, roll one D6, adding 3 if the unit is riled up. On a 4+, do not remove it until the unit has fought or the phase ends.

stratagems.name: Armed to da Teef
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when a friendly MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Re-roll Hit rolls of 1, or re-roll all Hit rolls while the unit is riled up.

stratagems.name: Hulking Brutes
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks with Strength greater than your unit's Toughness have -1 to Wound rolls. Alternatively, spend 1 additional CP for all ranged attacks to have -1 to Wound rolls.

rule.name: Sneaky Little Gitz
rule.rules_text: Friendly GRETCHIN units have the BATTLELINE keyword. When a friendly GRETCHIN unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move, that move does not prevent it from being eligible to start an action.

enhancements.name: Extra Sneaky
enhancements.rules_text: GRETCHIN unit only. This unit has -3 inches detection range.

enhancements.name: Minefield Detail
enhancements.rules_text: GRETCHIN unit only. While this unit is not embarked, it has Scouts 6 inches.

stratagems.name: Infested War Zone
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when an enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.target: One friendly GRETCHIN unit that was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Add a new GRETCHIN unit to your army in Strategic Reserves at its starting strength with its full wounds remaining.

stratagems.name: Scarper!
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8 inches of a friendly unengaged GRETCHIN unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6 inches, or up to 6 inches if it is an attached unit.

stratagems.name: Grot Shields
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit excluding GRETCHIN units.
stratagems.target: One friendly GRETCHIN unit within 3 inches of that ORKS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: When a Hit roll is successful, if a model in your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, end that attack sequence and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

rule.name: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
rule.rules_text: Friendly ORKS INFANTRY units' ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. While a unit is riled up, its ranged weapons have +3 inches Range.

enhancements.name: Supa-glowy Fing
enhancements.rules_text: ORKS INFANTRY model only, excluding WEIRDBOY models. This model's ranged attacks have [ANTI-INFANTRY 4+], [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] and [SUPA-HAZARDOUS]. After this unit shoots, roll one D6 for each Supa-hazardous weapon selected, to a maximum of two rolls; for each 1, one such weapon is destroyed.

enhancements.name: Targetin' Squigs
enhancements.rules_text: BIG MEK, BIGBOSS or WARBOSS model only. This unit's ranged attacks, excluding TORRENT attacks, have +3 inches Range.
restrictions: BIG MEK, BIGBOSS or WARBOSS model only.

stratagems.name: Kustom Dakka
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target a unit excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units have +1 to Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Glowin' Dakka
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit has finished shooting.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks that target a unit within 9 inches have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Never Enough Dakka
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rule.name: Suspiciously Well Organised
rule.rules_text: Friendly STORMBOYZ units have the BATTLELINE keyword. When a friendly BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move, that move does not prevent it from being eligible to start an action.

enhancements.name: Kill Kommando
enhancements.rules_text: BIG MEK or WARBOSS INFANTRY model only; LEADER: KOMMANDOS. While this model is part of an attached unit, that unit has Infiltrators and Stealth.
restrictions: BIG MEK or WARBOSS INFANTRY model only.

enhancements.name: Throat-slittas
enhancements.rules_text: KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit only. This unit's melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].

stratagems.name: Dubious Restraint
stratagems.timing: Start or end of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: Mind Mostly on the Mission
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

stratagems.name: While Their Backs Are Turned
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit that was engaged at the start of the phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6 inches.

rule.name: Wreckin' and Lootin'
rule.rules_text: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly BREAKA BOYZ, FLASH GITZ or TANKBUSTAS unit is selected to shoot, its attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 if that unit is within range of an objective marker or its target is within range of an objective marker.

enhancements.name: Kaptin's Hat
enhancements.rules_text: BIG MEK or WARBOSS INFANTRY model only; LEADER: FLASH GITZ. After both players have deployed, redeploy up to three friendly ORKS INFANTRY units, including into Strategic Reserves.
restrictions: BIG MEK or WARBOSS INFANTRY model only.

enhancements.name: Supa-snazz Dakka
enhancements.rules_text: FLASH GITZ unit only. While using the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, this unit's ranged weapons have [RAPID FIRE 1].

stratagems.name: Drive-by Bustin'
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS TRANSPORT unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks made with weapons selected for the Firing Deck ability have +1 to Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Grab It
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unengaged BREAKA BOYZ, FLASH GITZ or TANKBUSTAS unit has shot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6 inches and must end within range of an objective marker. It cannot declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Gun-crazy Show-offs
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One friendly FLASH GITZ or TANKBUSTAS unit hit by those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit shoots as if it were your Shooting phase, but can only target that enemy unit.

rule.name: Da Hunt Is On
rule.rules_text: Friendly BEAST SNAGGA units' attacks that target a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit have +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Glory Hog
enhancements.rules_text: BEAST SNAGGA model only. When this unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, that move does not prevent it from being eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: It Came From Da Drops
enhancements.rules_text: BEASTBOSS ON SQUIGSAUR model only. This model has +1 Toughness.

stratagems.name: Where D'Ya Fink You're Going?
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit engaged with a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.effect: The enemy unit must make a Desperate Escape. If it is a MONSTER or VEHICLE, subtract 1 from its hazard rolls for each engaging BEAST SNAGGA unit, and another 1 if that enemy is Battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Goaded Into Action
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit that lost a wound from those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6 inches; if it is riled up, you can re-roll that D6.

stratagems.name: Instinctive Hunters
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6 inches of a battlefield edge.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in Strategic Reserves.

rule.name: Unpredictable Genius
rule.rules_text: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly BIG MEK, MEK GUNZ, MORKANAUT or WAZBOM BLASTAJET unit attacks one enemy unit, roll one D6 once: 1 Dat's Weird - the target has a 4+ invulnerable save until your unit has shot; 2-3 Hop Splat - another enemy within 3 inches of the target suffers D3 mortal wounds; 4 Seekeez - those attacks have +1 to Hit rolls; 5 Lifted - the target has FLY and cannot benefit from cover until your unit has shot; 6 Runtrified - the target has -1 Toughness until your unit has shot.

enhancements.name: Mekwaaagh! Mastermind
enhancements.rules_text: BIG MEK model only. This unit is riled up.

enhancements.name: Temperamental Shokka
enhancements.rules_text: BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only. In your Shooting phase when selected to shoot, roll one D6: on a 1 this model is destroyed; on 2-5 its Shokk Attack Gun has +1 Attack; on a 6 it also has [SUSTAINED HITS 2].
restrictions: BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only.

enhancements.name: Enhanced Runt-maw
enhancements.rules_text: BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only. After this unit shoots, select one enemy unit hit by its attacks. Until the start of your next turn, while that unit is infested with Snottlings, it has -1 Leadership.
restrictions: BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only.

stratagems.name: Vindictive Artillerists
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MEK GUNZ unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS], [SUSTAINED HITS 1], or [HAZARDOUS], [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rule.name: Try Dat Button!
rule.rules_text: In your Shooting or Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit excluding TITANIC units is selected to attack, roll one D6 once, re-rolling duplicate results. Until it has attacked: 1-2 +1 Attack; 3-4 +2 Strength; 5-6 +1 AP. If two D6 were rolled, after attacking the unit makes one hazard roll.

enhancements.name: Cybork Boosta
enhancements.rules_text: BIG MEK or MEK model only. This model has +2 inches Movement.
restrictions: BIG MEK or MEK model only.

enhancements.name: Dreadherder
enhancements.rules_text: BIG MEK model only. While within 3 inches of a friendly ORKS WALKER excluding TITANIC, this model has Lone Operative. In your Shooting phase, select one such WALKER within 3 inches; its attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 until end of turn.

stratagems.name: Crazed Rampage
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS WALKER unit excluding TITANIC units.
stratagems.effect: When a model is destroyed before its unit has fought, roll one D6, adding 3 if riled up. On a 4+, do not remove it until its unit has fought or the phase ends.

stratagems.name: Dread Power
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

stratagems.name: Stomping Juggernaut
stratagems.timing: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit is selected to move or declare a charge.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.

rule.name: Unstoppable Momentum
rule.rules_text: Friendly WAGON units can re-roll Charge rolls. When a friendly WAGON unit is selected to Advance, change that Advance roll to 6.

enhancements.name: Targetin' Gizmos
enhancements.rules_text: WAGON unit only. While a BIG MEK model is embarked within this unit, its ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER]. If this unit is riled up, those attacks also have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Boss Boomer
enhancements.rules_text: WAGON unit only. While a WARBOSS model is embarked within this unit, it has that WARBOSS model's Intimidating Motivation or Keep Huntin' ability.

stratagems.name: Keep It Runnin'
stratagems.timing: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged ORKS INFANTRY unit eligible to fight and wholly within 3 inches of a friendly TRANSPORT it can embark within.
stratagems.effect: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: Readied Brawlers
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a Normal move.
stratagems.effect: Units embarked within your unit can make an Assault Disembark move.

stratagems.name: Impending Krunch
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a Charge move.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a Battle-shock roll with -1 to that roll.

rule.name: Adrenaline Junkies
rule.rules_text: Friendly WARBIKERS units have the BATTLELINE keyword. When a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move, its ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until end of turn and that move does not prevent it from being eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Smoky Gubbinz
enhancements.rules_text: SPEED FREEKS unit only, excluding AIRCRAFT units. When an attack targets this unit while it has the benefit of cover, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Competitive Streak
enhancements.rules_text: DEFFKILLA WARTRIKE model only. This unit can re-roll Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Delicious Eating Squigs
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.effect: Select any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3 inches of your unit. Each selected unit heals 3 wounds.

stratagems.name: Dakkastorm
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Speediest Freeks
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified Hit roll of 1-3.

rule.name: Skyborne Loons
rule.rules_text: Friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT units do not count towards the combined points value of your Strategic Reserves units. While a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit is riled up, its ranged attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Flyboss
enhancements.rules_text: ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only. This unit has the CHARACTER keyword. When this unit ends an Ingress move, each friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit within 6 inches is riled up until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Impulsive Recon
enhancements.rules_text: ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an Ingress move.

stratagems.name: Flyin' Headbutt
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT unit is destroyed, before rolling for Deadly Demise.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 12 inches and roll one D6; for each 4+, that enemy suffers 1 mortal wound. Then remove your unit.

stratagems.name: Long, Uncontrolled Bursts
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit.
stratagems.effect: When your unit's ranged attacks target a FLY unit, re-roll Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Whirligig Evasion
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged DEFFKOPTAS unit within 8 inches of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6 inches, or up to 6 inches if it is riled up.

rule.name: 'Ard as Nails
rule.rules_text: When a friendly WARBOSS model is destroyed, if its unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if the unit is riled up. On a 3+, do not remove the WARBOSS until its unit has fought or the phase ends.

enhancements.name: Surly as a Squiggoth
enhancements.rules_text: INFANTRY WARBOSS model only. Once per battle, each time this model is destroyed, roll one D6 at end of phase. On a 2+, set it back up as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Brutal but Kunnin'
enhancements.rules_text: WARBOSS model only. This model's melee attacks have +1 Damage.

enhancements.name: Blitzboss
enhancements.rules_text: WARBOSS model only. While this model is embarked within a TRANSPORT unit excluding WALKER units, that unit has +2 inches Movement and a 5+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Proper Killy
enhancements.rules_text: WARBOSS model only. This model's melee attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Morgog's Finkin' Cap
enhancements.rules_text: WARBOSS model only. Once per battle, per army, at the end of your opponent's Movement phase, if this unit is unengaged it can make a Normal move of up to D6 inches; if riled up, re-roll that D6.

enhancements.name: Da Gobshot Thunderbuss
enhancements.rules_text: WARBOSS model only. This model is equipped with Da Gobshot Thunderbuss: Range 24 inches, Attacks 6, BS 4+, Strength 7, AP -2, Damage 2, [RAPID FIRE 6], [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].

rule.name: Powers of da Waaagh!
rule.rules_text: Friendly ORKS PSYKER models' attacks have [PSYCHIC], +1 Strength, and an additional +1 Strength for every 5 models in this unit, or embarked within this model, rounding down.

enhancements.name: Da Krunch
enhancements.rules_text: ORKS PSYKER model only. This model is equipped with Da Krunch: Range 24 inches, Attacks 3, BS 3+, Strength 4, AP -1, Damage 1, [BLAST 3], [HAZARDOUS], [LETHAL HITS], [PSYCHIC].

enhancements.name: 'Eadbanger
enhancements.rules_text: ORKS PSYKER model only. This model is equipped with 'Eadbanger: Range 24 inches, Attacks 2, BS 4+, Strength 8, AP -3, Damage 3, [HAZARDOUS], [PRECISION], [PSYCHIC].

enhancements.name: Warphead
enhancements.rules_text: ORKS PSYKER model only. This model has Psyker Level 2, Deadly Demise D6 and can re-roll Psychic rolls.

additional_rules.name: Roar of Mork (psychic level 1)
additional_rules.rules_text: In your Movement phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, make a Psychic roll of one D6. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Otherwise, select one enemy unit excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units within 12 inches. That enemy has -1 to its Battle-shock roll for every 10 models in this unit.

additional_rules.name: Visions of Violence (psychic level 1)
additional_rules.rules_text: At the start of the Fight phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, make a Psychic roll of one D6. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Otherwise, this unit has Fights First.
